correctness.rationale: A closed walk in the four two-bit overlap states is exactly an indexed periodic input with the prescribed output, including the wrap constraints at n=1,2. Deterministic acceptance therefore counts a word once, even when it labels many closed walks. Reflection and conjugation by global bit complement preserve the image sizes by bijections. I independently reproduced the full displayed partition using /workspace/reproductions/cyclic_ca.py: direct output sets at n=1,…,6 for all 256 rules, followed by all-length tests using quotients by stable future-acceptance partitions of the four-start subset automata. For each within-group pair the difference is generated by the direct sum of the two quotient transition matrices, so matching the first d1+d2 coefficients including degree zero suffices by Cayley–Hamilton. All 48 tests passed, with maximum free-state count and comparison bound 2375 and 4750. Exactly 88 conventional representatives group as 8 of size one, 26 of size two, 4 of size four and 2 of size six. Sharpness is witnessed by Rules 7 and 41 with the same first five counts (2,4,5,12,22) and different sixth counts (43,46). This is an exact classifier of image sizes, not of languages or precursor multiplicities.
